name: Crayon
rationale: Enterprise-grade competitive intelligence platform tracking competitor website changes, messaging, and market signals — the primary upper-market alternative AIS Market is positioned against.

name: Klue
rationale: AI-powered competitive enablement platform for mid-to-enterprise SaaS teams that aggregates competitor intelligence and delivers battlecards — a direct upper-market competitor.

name: Kompyte
rationale: Automated competitor tracking tool that monitors website changes, ads, and reviews and generates battlecards, directly overlapping with AIS Market's core feature set.

name: Similarweb
rationale: Widely used competitor and market intelligence platform offering traffic, audience, and digital strategy insights that product and marketing teams use as a competitive research tool.

name: Owler
rationale: Freemium competitive intelligence platform delivering news alerts and company insights on competitors, targeting the same mid-market teams with limited CI budgets.

name: Contify
rationale: Market and competitive intelligence platform that aggregates and curates competitor signals into reports for product and marketing teams, directly competing on automated CI delivery.

name: Battlecards by Workbooks (formerly Compete IQ / Battlecards.io)
rationale: Competitive battlecard and intelligence tool aimed at sales and marketing teams at SaaS companies who need structured competitor insights without enterprise-level investment.

name: Wappalyzer
rationale: Technology intelligence and competitor tracking tool used by SaaS marketers to monitor competitor tech stacks and website signals, partially overlapping with AIS Market's website monitoring use case.

name: SpyFu
rationale: Affordable competitor research tool focused on SEO and PPC intelligence, used by marketing teams as a low-cost alternative to enterprise CI platforms.

name: SEMrush
rationale: Dominant digital marketing intelligence suite used by SaaS teams to track competitor online presence, content, and advertising — a frequent DIY substitute for dedicated CI tools.

name: G2 Market Intelligence
rationale: G2's buyer intent and competitive intelligence product tracks competitor review trends and category positioning, targeting the same product and marketing teams at mid-size SaaS companies.

name: Visualping
rationale: Website change monitoring tool used by SaaS teams to track competitor website updates automatically, directly overlapping with AIS Market's competitor website messaging tracking feature.
